sn42.5:1.1: Atha kho assāroho gāmaṇi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho assāroho gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.5:1.2: Sutam me tam bhante pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānam assārohānam bhasamānānaṃ ||
sn42.5:1.3: Yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tam enam ussahantam vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Sarājitānam devānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
sn42.5:1.5: Alaṃ gāmani tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti || || 4
sn42.5:2.2: Tatiyam pi kho assāroho gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.5:2.3: Sutam me tam bhante pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānam assārohānam bhāsamānānam
sn42.5:2.4: Yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tam enam ussahantaṃ vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā || pe || sahavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
sn42.5:3.1: Addhā kho tyāhaṃ gāmaṇi na labhāmi
sn42.5:3.2: Alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti ||
sn42.5:3.4: Yo so gāmaṇi assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tassa taṃ cittam pubbeva hīnaṃ duggataṃ duppaṇihitaṃ
sn42.5:3.5: Ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā ahesum itivāti ||
sn42.5:3.6: tam enam ussahantaṃ vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Sarājito nāma nirayo tattha upapajjati || ||
sn42.5:3.7: Sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti ||
sn42.5:3.8: Yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tam enam ussahantam vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sarājitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi || ||
sn42.5:3.9: Micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāham gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnam aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi ||
sn42.5:4.1: Evaṃ vutte assāroho gāmani parodi assūni pavattesi || ||
sn42.5:4.3: Alaṃ gāmani tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti || ||
sn42.5:4.4: Nāham bhante etam rodāmi yam mam Bhagavā etam āha ||
